name: ChatGPT
description: OpenAI's browser assistant for conversation, writing, coding and working with files. Features and limits vary by plan.

name: Gemini
description: Google's AI assistant for questions, writing and multimodal tasks, with Google account and plan requirements.

name: Claude
description: Anthropic's conversational assistant for drafting, reasoning, coding and discussing documents in the browser.

name: Microsoft Copilot
description: Microsoft's web assistant for conversation, web-backed questions and creative tasks. Availability varies by region and account.

name: Le Chat
description: Mistral's browser chat assistant for exploring ideas, answering questions and helping with writing or code.

name: Perplexity
description: An AI answer engine that pairs responses with source links. Open the sources to verify claims before relying on them.

name: NotebookLM
description: Google's source-focused research notebook for asking questions about material you supply and organizing your study notes.

name: Elicit
description: An AI research assistant for finding academic papers and comparing evidence. Check original papers for context and accuracy.

name: You.com
description: A browser-based AI service for research and answering questions, with tools and access that depend on your plan.

name: Poe
description: A place to try multiple AI bots through one interface. Each bot can have different usage allowances and capabilities.

name: Grok
description: xAI's web chat assistant for questions and creative tasks. Confirm current access requirements and verify factual answers.

name: Adobe Firefly
description: Adobe's browser tools for generative creative work. Check credit limits and licensing terms before using output commercially.

name: Ideogram
description: A browser image-generation service with tools for visual concepts and typography. Usage limits vary by subscription.

name: Runway
description: AI-powered creative tools for generating and editing moving images. Review plan credits and output terms before starting.

name: Suno
description: A web service for experimenting with AI-generated music and songs. Commercial use depends on the service's plan and terms.
